description:
I submitted a Householder Planning Application for demolishing the existing front boundary wall and left flank storage room (shed) and proposed a single storey front extension with flat roof and two skylight windows and rebuilding the existing storage room and front boundary wall.
 
I proposed to downsize the front single storey extension with flat roof as recommended by the pre-planning officer in pre-planning report development floor area a= 43.35m² and proposed to demolish existing left flank shed (storage room) which is in dilapidation conditions and rebuild as existing scale to meet current building control regulation (as recommended in pre-planning report)
 
The existing shed will be built on the same footprint as the existing floor area of the existing shed (storage room) is a= 11.15m². We also proposed to demolish existing boundary brick wall which is also in dilapidation condition to rebuild boundary brick wall will NOT increase in heights over existing height of the boundary brick wall will be the same height we will match as much as possible brick colours and type (as suggested in the pre-planning report).
 
The proposal of the downsized front single storey extension, rebuild existing shed storage room) and rebuild boundary brick wall will follow strictly pre-planning report advice the external extension, shed (storage room) and boundary brick wall will match existing colour of the brick to match main house external brick wall (as suggested in pre-planning report).
 
The single storey front extension flat roof with two skylight windows to meet current planning and building control regulation for the end terrace single-family house at above address (see proposed drawings for further details).
 
The proposed front single storey extension rebuilds existing shed (storeroom and rebuild front boundary wall will blend within existing streetscene and will not have any negative impact to the adjacent properties or to the surrounding area.
